logicalMode: Use caller-owned opaque collection identity plus separate data allocation identity. Track exact count/capacity/stride/all data bytes and live/freed status; header identity remains stable across SetCapacity, data identity changes.
Preserve allocation/clear/copy/free order; header and data are separate allocations. Address-free logical events must leave native handle binding explicitly unresolved.

nativeMode: Authoritative Frame+90 FrameHeap identity, Heap._memory base, Config/page/bins/free chains/tracker snapshot and actual allocation policy/failure/rollback behavior. This is a different ABI from component data buffer native allocator.

allocateList(heapDraft,{elementType,capacity,stride,headerBytes:16,initialCount:0,callSite}) returns post heap snapshot, caller collection identity, actual nonzero signed32 headerHandle AND dataHandle, exact header/data bytes and allocation facts. resolveList uses SAME heap identity and actual signed32 headerHandle. Read header16 and data bytes using its actual dataHandle, validate count/capacity/stride and lifetime. Do not cache data pointer across SetCapacity or assume logical ID equals physical handle.
SetCapacity allocates new data and binds new actual dataHandle before old data Free; existing headerHandle unchanged. Copy count*stride, preserve proper truncation and zero new unused bytes.
